name: regenerative_two_shaft_gas_turbine
title: Regenerative two-shaft gas turbine (THD10 R05 exercise 4)
summary: Gas turbine plant on ideal-gas air: compressor, regenerator, combustion chamber, a HP turbine driving only the compressor and a LP (power) turbine expanding to ambient pressure. The seven stations are solved simultaneously from the compressor and turbine isentropic efficiencies (95 %) and the regenerator effectiveness (90 %).
